mo_ta_cong_viec:
JOB PURPOSE:
This position is responsible for leading the design, implementation, administration, monitoring, and continuous improvement of the Company's infrastructure platforms, including servers, storage, Active Directory, messaging systems, virtualization, cloud services, and related technologies.
This role ensuresthe availability, security,performance, resilience, and scalability of the Company's technology infrastructure while supporting business growth, digital transformation initiatives, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence. The position also providesleadership to the System Administration team, driving innovation, operational efficiency, and service quality.
PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:
Lead the design, architecture, and implementation of infrastructure solutions, including servers, storage, virtualization platforms, Active Directory, messaging systems, cloud services, backup, and disaster recovery solutions.
Manage, mentor, and develop the System Administration team by assigning priorities, monitoring performance, building technical capabilities, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Oversee the administration, monitoring, maintenance, and optimization of infrastructure platforms to ensure system availability, reliability, and performance across all company locations.
Ensure compliance with IT governance standards, cybersecurity policies, technology procedures, Enterprise Architectures and regulatory requirements to protect critical infrastructure and information assets.
Manage backup, disaster recovery (DR), and business continuity (BCP) capabilities to ensure operational resilience and periodic recovery readiness.
Lead problem management activities, including root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and resolution of infrastructure, system, and platform-related incidents.
Drive infrastructure modernization initiatives by evaluating emerging technologies and recommending solutions that improve efficiency, security, scalability, and user experience.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders, vendors, and project teams to deliver infrastructure services and support strategic technology initiatives.
Manage infrastructure budgets, asset lifecycle planning, vendor relationships, maintenance contracts, and technology procurement activities.
